title: How to Write a Classification Essay — With Examples
skills: organize a broad topic into meaningful categories
support each category with relevant examples and explanation
structure a classification essay with a focused introduction, organized body paragraphs, and conclusion
alignment_note: Explains how to organize information into logical categories and develop a classification essay using clear criteria, examples, and structured paragraphs. Supports expository writing, informational organization, analytical thinking, coherence, and essay development across high school English courses.
